1  THIS MFA IS FILED U/SEC.54(1) OF LAND ACQUISITION  ACT, AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DTD 19.08.2010  PASSED IN LAC.NO.2/2007 ON THE FILE OF THE ADDITIONAL  SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE, JAMKHANDI, SITTING AT MUDHOL,
 PARTLY ALLOWING THE REFERENCE PETITION FILED UNDER  SECTION 18(1) OF L.A.ACT.
 THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR FURTHER HEARING, THIS  DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 -2-  NC: 2023:KHC-D:12079  MFA No. 100436 of 2021  JUDGMENT

This appeal is by the land loser seeking enhancement of compensation being aggrieved by the judgment and award dated 19.08.2010 in LAC No.2/2007 on the file of the Senior Civil Judge,
Jamkhandi sitting at Mudhol.

2. The appellant's land bearing Survey No.30/3 measuring 4 acres 10 guntas in Warchgal village, Tq:
Mudhol, was the subject matter of the Land Acquisition in terms of notification issued under Section 4(1) of the Land Acquisition Act 1894.
3. The Special Land Acquisition Officer has passed an award fixing Rs.41,470/- per acre.
Being not satisfied with the compensation awarded, the appellant sought reference.
The Reference Court has awarded a compensation of Rs.1,80,000/- per acre.
Again the land loser is not satisfied with the award.
Hence, he is before this Court seeking enhancement.

Sri. Anil Kale, learned counsel appearing for the appellant would submit that the land in question was the sugarcane growing land and fetched higher market value, than what is determined by the Reference Court and he would place reliance on the judgment of the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in MFA No.23171/2013.
In the said case, this Court has fixed Rs.2,22,000/- per acre as the market value in respect of the land which was the subject matter of the acquisition in terms of notification dated 07.11.2002.
It is also forthcoming from the said judgment that the land acquired in the said case was the land situated in Warchgal village, taluk Mudhol bearing Sy.No.32/1+2 measuring 4 acres 37 guntas.
5. It is also forthcoming that the land loser in the said case was growing sugarcane, and this Court has considered the records in this case.
It is also forthcoming that the land is from the same village namely, Warchgal, taluk Mudhol, and the land is sugarcane growing land.

sentences.text: The learned counsel appearing for the respondent would not dispute the facts narrated above.
In the aforementioned case, this court has determined the market value of Rs.2,22,000/- per acre.

It is relevant to note that in the said case, the acquisition took place on 07.11.2002, whereas in this case,
the acquisition has taken place after ten months from the said notification.

7. This being the position, this court is of the considered view that that the present appellant is also entitled to the market value of Rs.2,22,000/- per acre for the land acquired with all statutory consequential benefits subject to the conditions imposed while allowing the application for condonation of delay in filing this appeal and the application for amendment of the plaint.
8. It is to be noticed that claim petition was initially filed in respect of 1 acre 11 guntas of land though the land acquired was 4 acres 10 guntas.
Before this Court, an application was filed for amending the extent of the land in the reference petition.
This Court has allowed NC: 2023:KHC-D:12079 the said application subject to certain conditions.
It is further noticed that there was a delay in filing the appeal.
This Court vide order dated 16.11.2022 condoned the delay subject to the condition that the appellant is not entitled to interest for the delayed period, in case the compensation is enhanced.

9. The conditions imposed while allowing the application for amendment are as under:-
The beneficiary is liable to pay interest on Rs.1,80,000/- per acre the market value determined by reference Court on amended extent of 2 acres and 39 guntas till the date when the compensation was deposited by the beneficiary in respect of 1 acre and 11 guntas.

In case, the market value is enhanced by this Court, the beneficiary is liable to pay interest in respect of compensation enhanced by this Court on the entire 4 acres and 11 guntas excluding the delayed period in filing the appeal.

In other words NC:
2023:KHC-D:12079 even if compensation is enhanced by this Court, the beneficiary is under no obligation to pay the interest on Rs.1,80,000/- per acre the market value determined by reference Court on amended extent of 2 acres and 39 guntas for the period beyond 8.11.2006 the date on which beneficiary deposited the amount before reference Court.

And obligation to pay up to date interest is only in respect of market value enhanced by this Court and not on the market value determined by the reference Court in so far as amended extent of 2 acres and 39 guntas.
The application is allowed subject to the condition enumerated above.
10. Hence, the appellant is not entitled to interest for the delayed period of 3799 days in respect of the enhanced compensation.
Hence the appellants are not entitled to interest for certain amount for certain period explained in the operative portion of this order.

vii.
